sources.dwr_page: https://dwr.virginia.gov/hunting/regulations/publiclands/ (State Parks section only points to the DCR page)

general_rules: Hunting only in designated areas; hunting prohibited within 100 yards of park buildings and roads.

Reservation (managed deer) hunts: $15 non-refundable reservation per day at reservevaparks.com or 1-800-933-7275 option 5; reservations open 9 a.m. on the chart date; hunter education proof required at check-in; every hunt has its own terms (hunt packet).
Open hunts (Fairy Stone, Grayson Highlands, Hungry Mother, Occoneechee): no reservation, all DWR regulations apply, daily parking fee.
Weapon key from the chart: A archery, M muzzleloader, S shotgun, Ss shotgun slugs only, G general firearms; * special qualification required and non-lead ammunition required.
differences_from_app: Widewater State Park is missing from public-lands.geojson: build-geo.sh drops any DCR feature whose MANAME matches /water/, which catches 'Widewater'. It has a 2026-27 managed hunt. Geometry in state-parks.geojson; fix the filter to e.g. / - water$/ or MANAME !== 'Philpott Reservoir - water'.

Holliday Lake State Park (560 ac, not open to hunting) is entirely inside Appomattox-Buckingham State Forest in the DCR layer; the -union keeps the state-forest name, so the app shows the park as A-B State Forest with the state-forest firearms season. It should be cut out and shown as a closed state park.

Falkland State Conservation Area (DCR land holding run by Staunton River State Park, 7,323 ac) is not in the app; it holds the 2026-27 Staunton River managed hunt (Nov 19-20, general firearms). Geometry in state-parks.geojson.

Fairy Stone, Grayson Highlands and Hungry Mother: deer-2026.ts applies their DWR firearms seasons to the whole park polygon, but only designated portions are open (Grayson Highlands 1,117 ac north section via Massie Gap/Seed Orchard Trail; Hungry Mother 863 ac north section off Rt 16; Fairy Stone the cooperative DWR/USACE area). deer-2025.ts carried a 'Designated areas only.' note for Fairy Stone; deer-2026.ts dropped it. Add a 'designated open-hunt area only' note to all three (no GIS for the sub-areas was found; DCR publishes only PDF maps).

Occoneechee State Park: open hunt on 1,900 ac in the southeast part, all DWR rules, but deer-2026.ts has no firearms rule for it, so it falls to unlistedPublicPolicy.state_park = 'check'. DWR's public-lands table does not list it, so firearms dates follow the private-land season for Mecklenburg County (the either-sex rules already single it out). Consider 'private-rules' plus a designated-area note.

The 18 other parks with reservation, permit or cooperative hunts get only the generic 'check DCR' note. These are deer-only managed hunts on specific dates; showing the dates and weapons per park (table below) would help, but the land outside those dates is closed.

Grayson Highlands also has reservation hunts (Nov 2-3 muzzleloader, Nov 16-17 general firearms, 30 hunters/day) in addition to the open hunt; deer-2026.ts encodes only the open-hunt season (Nov 14-28).
